why: DMN 1.6 §10.3.2.3.4: "A time in the semantic domain is a value of the XML Schema time datatype." XML Schema Part 2 §3.2.7.3: timezones have "the minute magnitude limited to at most 59", and in the lexical representation "mm is a two-digit numeral that represents the minutes". An offset with 60 or more minutes is no offset: the literal is invalid and gives null, instead of carrying the minutes into the hours (+05:99 was +06:39).
